title: Review Helm chart and OAuth2-proxy config
Remove empty Qdrant from n8n Coolify target
description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC-001: The n8n Coolify Compose target contains only n8n and PostgreSQL; it declares no Qdrant service, volume, dependency, or URL.
- [ ] AC-002: The migration runbook requires only PostgreSQL and n8n-state restore, preserving the n8n encryption-key gate.
- [ ] AC-003: The documented per-environment cap reflects the two-service target.

## Verification
- `docker compose --env-file deploy/coolify/compose.example.env -f deploy/coolify/compose.yaml config --quiet`
- `helm lint deploy/helm/n8n`
- `helm template` assertions for `ollama.replicas: 0` and default `replicas: 1`
- static assertions that the target exposes exactly `n8n` and `postgres`

## Evidence
Live nonprod read-only observation 2026-08-10: dev and staging Qdrant storage each used 36 KiB with two files. Operator direction is n8n plus PostgreSQL only; no Qdrant target is justified.
close_reason: Source follow-up completed: removed Qdrant from the Coolify target and its restore envelope. Evidence: Compose config, Helm lint, zero/default Ollama renders, and exact-service static checks pass; live read-only Qdrant storage was 36 KiB in both dev and staging.
